_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

rule_paths.reason: ycash6's code-scanning triage script, accepted there for the same reason (2026-10-24): its one subprocess call runs `gh api` with an argv list (no shell) built from constants and the workflow-supplied repository name, only in code-scanning.yml with that job's own token. A subprocess call anywhere else is still reported.
Test code: a panic is how a test fails; the Result return is the test harness's, not an error path of the node.
Startup: kogany's RPC server start mirrors upstream's `.expect("server should start")` beside it; a node that cannot bind its configured RPC port must stop at startup.
Weighted eviction pick: `pick` is drawn below the summed weights of the same candidate list, so `find` always matches; the expect states that invariant.
Both expects are proved by the lines above them: time-based locks are rejected first, and a u32 coin height plus a 16-bit lock fits the u32 height after the range check.
Upstream Zakura's line (only re-flowed around the Ycash regtest difficulty): the state's expected difficulty is always a valid compact value.
The post-quantum verifier FFI (SLH-DSA, Falcon-512) is necessarily unsafe; each call carries a SAFETY comment on the pointer and length contract, and the verifiers write through none of the pointers.
libc::mallopt at process start before any worker thread, as its SAFETY comment states (upstream's allocator tuning, moved with the binary rename).
Upstream design: the runtime stage starts as root and entrypoint.sh drops to the image user with setpriv (Dockerfile comments at the runtime stage).
The RPC contract's example responses: placeholder addresses and a dummy key id, no secret.
Test and gate harnesses: they launch the locally built koganyd / ycashd / client binaries with argv lists (no shell) from their own arguments; never run on untrusted input.
Test and gate harnesses: the URL is the regtest node's own RPC endpoint on 127.0.0.1 the harness started.
Fixture regenerator: imports the sibling test-data module by its computed path; a developer tool, not shipped.
